name: email-inbox
description: Tabbed email inbox digest block with preview items, unread state, chips, and animated tab indicator.

files.description: Base Item primitives (Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions, ItemHeader, ItemFooter). Dependency of PreviewItem.
Generic preview item block. Accepts icon, title, subtitle, description, timestamp, unread state, badge, tags, and chipSlot. Reusable for email, tasks, notifications.
Email-specific wrapper around PreviewItem. Maps sender/subject/preview/attachments to the correct slots.
Task-specific wrapper around PreviewItem. Uses priority icons matching the work board convention.
Generic Card-based tabbed list container with animated sliding tab indicator, dynamic height lock, and optional footer slot.
Composed email inbox digest. Renders EmailPreviewItem lists across High importance / Flagged / Unread tabs with a Go to Mail footer.
